firm_note.text: Sensible Money's positioning centers on personalized, non-formulaic financial planning, with a stated mission to "create the freedom to live life without the stress of money." The firm emphasizes five core values (integrity, accountability, customization, exceptional service, and culture) and has been named to the Inc. 5000 for three consecutive years (2022-2024), recognized by USA Today among top advisory firms (2025-2026), and named a best place to work for financial advisors (2025-2026).
